data.title: The old warehouse maze
story: Final challenge: the old warehouse is full of branching corridors and dead ends. The corridor-finder program gets lost at the branches.
Use the right-hand rule: at every step, turn right first. While there is still a wall in front, turn left. Then move forward. The robot will follow the wall all the way to the flag.

explanation: The right-hand rule follows the wall on the right, so the robot always reaches the flag in a maze whose walls are connected. The while loop inside the while finds the first open direction.
hints: The old program only turns when it hits a wall, so side branches get skipped. The right-hand rule always tries right first.
The order: pick up a package if there is one, turn_right(), then while not front_clear(): turn_left(), then forward().
The inner while is indented 4 more spaces. deliver() goes at the very bottom with no indentation.
